chunks: ʿAlī ibn Mahziyār, from Faḍālah, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from Abī al-ʿAbbās, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The minimum that suffices for Jumuʿah is seven, or five at the lowest.

Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan said: There is no contradiction between these two reports, because obligation is connected to the number when they are seven; and when the number is five, that is recommended and encouraged, and it is not an obligatory duty. If it is less than five, then the Jumuʿah does not take place at all. That which indicates this is:

key_terms.الْفَرْضَ: that which is obligatory and binding
key_terms.يُجْزِي: is sufficient or valid for fulfilling the requirement

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum number required for salat al-Jumuʿah in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This report discusses the minimum number required for the Friday prayer and presents two thresholds: seven for obligation and five for recommended validity. Al-Shaykh explains that the reports are reconciled by distinguishing between what is obligatory and what is merely recommended, while fewer than five does not establish Jumuʿah at all.
